resources.string: Shizuku or root

With Shizuku running, or root, the keyboard can grant itself what you would otherwise turn on screen by screen in system Settings. Every grant shows up there as usual and is taken back there. Nothing here runs until you turn it on.
Use Shizuku or root for keyboard features
One-tap grants below, and reading the chat for AI reply
Make this the keyboard
Turns WM Keyboard on in the keyboard list and switches to it
Grant every permission
Microphone, camera, contacts and the rest at once, without a prompt each
Notification access
For one-time codes on the suggestion strip and media controls
Codes Android hides
Android 15 and later hide one-time codes in notifications from the keyboard. This lets it read them for the code chip
Screen reading service
Turns on the accessibility service the floating AI button reads the screen with
Write secure settings
Lets the app launcher change freeform windows without a shell each time
System spell checker
Makes WM Keyboard\'s spell checker the one every app uses
AI reply reads the chat
When the reply panel opens, the messages on screen are added, yours on the right and theirs on the left
Done
Capture the screen
OCR, Translate and AI reply get a button that reads the screen above the keyboard, with no screen recording prompt
Android refused. Check Shizuku or your root manager.
Start Shizuku and allow the keyboard, or turn on root, first
